spec.summary: Optional API key authentication via ANVIL_API_KEY env var. When set, all requests must include Authorization: Bearer <key> header. When unset, no auth required (dev mode).
implementation_notes: Check ANVIL_API_KEY env var at startup
If set, validate Authorization header on every request (except OPTIONS for CORS)
Skip auth entirely if ANVIL_API_KEY is not set (dev-friendly default)
Add auth check early in request handler, before route matching
Log auth mode at startup: 'API key auth enabled' or 'Running without auth (dev mode)'
acceptance_criteria: When ANVIL_API_KEY is set, requests without valid Bearer token get 401
When ANVIL_API_KEY is unset, all requests pass through (no auth)
Correct key in Authorization header allows access
